BATCH B — all seven RECOMMENDED answers chosen, each now an approved repair direction with its exact rule: D8 APPROVED-FIX — when last night's sleep is missing, recovery is UNKNOWN and no sleep restriction is applied today; every other recovery check still applies (not carry-forward of the last logged night). D10 APPROVED-FIX — date-only week counts mean 7 CALENDAR days, not 168 elapsed hours. D16 APPROVED-FIX — a 7-day forecast hit requires an eligible weigh-in on the due day or, failing that, the next day (one grace date); with no such reading the forecast is UNGRADED, not a miss; the day arithmetic follows D10. D25 APPROVED-FIX — "protein: good" requires at least one successful day within the current seven-logged-days window before the one-miss allowance applies; a first missed day cannot read "good". D32 APPROVED-FIX — "benefit replicated" counts only sessions from the CURRENT technique; all other replication thresholds stay as they are. D37 APPROVED-FIX — a merged earned receipt keeps the assessment as of the day it was earned, accepting that this can change whether a single-sighting increase counts as earned and the numbers printed on past earned receipts. D40 APPROVED-FIX — when two phones disagree on a day's calories with equal detail, ONE deterministic shared winner is chosen with the conflict kept visible and BOTH original entries retained; the exact tie-break rule and how the conflict is shown are NOT decided here and must be specified in the reviewed fix brief before anything is built. Totals: 45/45 dispositions recorded, 45 APPROVED-FIX, 0 KEEP, 0 DEFER, 0 UNRULED. What this does NOT do: it approves directions, not code — each theme still needs its accepted behaviour/delta brief, its red-first laws turning GREEN on the candidate and RED on the frozen engine, the post-fix gate's PACKAGE run and cowork's execution acceptance; the frozen app and its goldens stay untouched; no private release, spending, phone gate, remote gate or M2 closure is waived; no owner-specific interval or value is set. THE SEVEN TOOLING FACTS, NAMED BEFORE THE FIRST RUN AND SINCE LANDED BY S7-TOOLING (DECISIONS:511). The integrator hand that assembled this file was barred from touching product or test bytes, so seven facts stood between it and a run; the refusal chain and the diff per file are in rebuild/lanes/b/S7-TOOLING-AUTHOR-REPORT.md. (1) IDS at b-package.cjs:165 was [B-NTC,H3,S3,S4,S5,S6,B1,B2,B4,B3] and the argv gate at :557 refused any other id outright (B PACKAGE USAGE REFUSED, exit 1, before this spec was opened); S7 now stands directly behind S6, eleven ids. (2) NO_REGISTER_IDS at :292 gains S7, and without it the run refused REGISTER-D-ID-INVENTORY-EMPTY-AND-NOT-EXEMPT; S7 is an S- id, so the shape assertion admits it without a PM by-name ruling, exactly as S3, S4, S5 and S6 were admitted. (3) CHILD_ROOTS at :381 gains rebuild/lanes/d/p3-port-fix/ as its nineteenth root, and without it the declared child `d-port-admission` was refused CHILD-ARGV-TARGET and the Y1 own-child obligation (MIN_OWN_CHILDREN = 1) could not be met at all; the root is deliberately NOT added to PUBLIC_TAIL_ROOTS. (4) The five s7-supersede-*.test.cjs cells and s7-engine-files-differential.cjs now exist beside the s6-* family, each mirrored from its S6 sibling with the package, parent and generation named for S7 and no assertion weakened, because the s6-* family reads packages/S6.json by path and asserts against S6's own parent and sourceBase, and a retirement is never inherited - only the gate list is. (5) Moving b-package.cjs moves tooling.runnerSha256, so packages/H3.json, S3.json, S4.json and S5.json are re-pinned role `edited` and packages/S6.json is role `superseded-by-child` over the parent EXECUTION pin; S5.json is in that list because S6 re-pinned all four of ITS ancestors the same way at commit 7e5fcca. (6) F6 and F7 in rebuild/lanes/b/tooling/test/pinned-unchanged-and-ruled-substitutions.test.cjs take the new lists by literal and by deepEqual: IDS of eleven, NO_REGISTER_IDS of seven, CHILD_ROOTS of nineteen. (7) The four CHILD_SPECS cells (measure/test/boundary.test.mjs, today/test/food.test.mjs, today/test/machine-settings-ui.test.mjs, today/test/setup.test.mjs) and the fifth at today/test/problem.test.mjs gain the S7 literal; without it the today-17 child went red on two cells because moves this package declares read there as undeclared drift.

THE NEEDLES ARE MEASURED, NOT CARRIED. All 24 children were run on this head the way children() runs them (node, cwd = the worktree, TZ=America/New_York, MEASURED_TEST_NOW=2026-09-03), and each needle below is what its own run printed. 23 of 24 stand exactly where S6 left them, including the six that execute a file this package MOVES: w6-local-source # pass 26, w7-import # pass 35, d-import-retract # pass 13, m4-import # pass 62 and m4-import-production # pass 28. ONE MOVED: d-plan-edit, # pass 68 at S6 and # pass 89 here, because rebuild/lanes/d/plan-edit/model.test.cjs carries binding correction B-1 of the spec review and the FIX-2 cells. The `d-port-admission` needle # pass 31 was DECISIONS:510's lane figure and was the one number in this file read from a report rather than measured; it is now measured and it agrees. today-17 reads # pass 682 once fact (7) has landed, and went red on exactly two cells before it did.

THE NINE GATES ARE RETIRED AGAIN, a fifth time, and the reason is structural rather than this package's doing. The nine NATIVE-CARRIERS gates are byte-identity RECONSTRUCTIONS of rebuild/engine from a frozen BASE; four of the files they rebuild were moved by this package's ancestors (constants.cjs and writers.cjs by M2-H3-CLEAN-INIT, merge.cjs and today.cjs by M2-S3-COMPANION), so no descendant of S3 can carry them whether or not it moves an engine byte of its own. S7 moves none: all 45 tracked engine files stand at the parent's own post. The parent retired them under its own token line DECISIONS:490; a retirement is never inherited, only the gate list is, so this package retires them AGAIN under its OWN token line with its OWN evidence in S6's exact shape.

THE SEALING WINDOW, AND WHY NO CELL IS EDITED FOR IT. VERDICT-S6.md rule (b) and DECISIONS:499: standingSeal(repoRoot) reads the standing package off the CI flag. With the flag at S7 and receipts/S7.json absent, the window branch applies: packages/S7.json must exist and be BRIEF-ACCEPTED and name a parent.chosen whose receipt exists. It does - S6, receipts/S6.json sha256 5bff018d56223d9876c6e5600616e7c52550343daded088bc2dd95fdae7ba4c1 - so the constant must equal M2-S6-TODAY-CHILD@5bff018d56223d98, which is exactly where rebuild/coach/engine-revision.cjs stands and where it stays for the whole of this window. P3-M3 in rebuild/m4/import/test/production-mapping.test.cjs, the coach cell rebuild/coach/test/engine-revision.test.cjs and P3-P6-SEAL-WINDOW in production-admission.test.mjs all read that rule and all stay GREEN through the window; they become trip-wires again the moment receipts/S7.json lands. This package edits none of them and carries all three byte-identical.

This package registers no D-id (DECISIONS:93, the S- slice-plan half); its obligation is the Y1 own-child rule, satisfied by the `d-port-admission` child that executes its own three role:new cells under the child root rebuild/lanes/d/p3-port-fix/ the S7-TOOLING round added. `notes` is not carried into the sealed artifact.
